rationale: Price is sitting exactly at today's low with no sign of stabilization — the last two 1-minute candles show continued selling pressure and the stock is already down ~6.6% from prior close after a prior-day drop from $71.74. While elevated relative volume (4x) and a large gap could attract dip buyers, the fundamental backdrop (massive debt load, negative FCF, rising bond yields on its own debt) and the fact that price is making new session lows with no base formation make a reliable entry in either direction difficult to justify. The risk/reward is unclear without a defined support level holding, so skipping preserves capital until a cleaner setup emerges.
